# Adapters

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:gen` from the code. Do not edit: `pnpm test` fails when it is stale. -->

The files of `daemon/src/adapters/`, each the I/O of one outside system.

| Adapter                             | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `adapters/claude/claude.ts`         | Runs one headless `claude -p` process with stream-json output: logs every line, reports the usage windows it sees, and returns the final result event.                                                                          |
| `adapters/claude/run-log.ts`        | Run logs on disk: claude's stream-json lines plus the daemon's own `agentdeck_*` events.                                                                                                                                        |
| `adapters/git/diffs.ts`             | Adapter for local git: diffs and compares, and reading trees and files at a commit.                                                                                                                                             |
| `adapters/git/exec.ts`              | Running git: the one way every other git file starts a process.                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `adapters/git/refs.ts`              | Adapter for local git: refs and history, what is checked out and which commits there are.                                                                                                                                       |
| `adapters/git/repo-root.ts`         | Reads what toolchain detection looks at in a repo's root directory.                                                                                                                                                             |
| `adapters/git/workspace.ts`         | Adapter for the Workspace port (application/ports/workspace.ts): git, the shell and a worktree's files, grouped into the operations the use cases need, on git.ts, shell.ts, plan-file.ts, protected-edits.ts and repo-root.ts. |
| `adapters/git/worktrees.ts`         | Adapter for local git: worktrees, and committing and merging in them.                                                                                                                                                           |
| `adapters/github/github.ts`         | Adapter for pushing branches and managing pull requests with git and gh.                                                                                                                                                        |
| `adapters/github/issues.ts`         | Adapter for reading a repo's GitHub issues and reporting back on them with gh.                                                                                                                                                  |
| `adapters/local/daemon-api.ts`      | Asks a running daemon about itself over its HTTP API.                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `adapters/local/daemon-log.ts`      | Reads the end of the daemon's log file.                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `adapters/local/goals.ts`           | The goals file of each repo, `<GOALS_DIR>/<repo name>.md`, read by the planner.                                                                                                                                                 |
| `adapters/local/plan-file.ts`       | The plan file in a task's worktree (PLAN_FILE): where a run's plan is put for the worker and read back after it, with the copy the run was given beside it (PLAN_GIVEN_FILE).                                                   |
| `adapters/local/protected-edits.ts` | Protected edits in a task's worktree (domain/repos/protected-edits.ts): what a worker wrote to the edits folder, copied to its place, committed on the task's branch, and the folder cleared.                                   |
| `adapters/macos/caffeinate.ts`      | Keeps the Mac from idle-sleeping while agents work, with a `caffeinate -i` assertion.                                                                                                                                           |
| `adapters/macos/notify.ts`          | Delivers a notification on the desktop (osascript) and to ntfy.                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `adapters/macos/service.ts`         | Runs the daemon as a per-user launchd agent: starts at login, restarted if it dies.                                                                                                                                             |
| `adapters/macos/watch.ts`           | Watches the daemon's own source so it can notice it is running stale code.                                                                                                                                                      |
| `adapters/process/processes.ts`     | Process groups of claude runs: stopping them on shutdown, and after a crash.                                                                                                                                                    |
| `adapters/process/shell.ts`         | Runs a repo's own commands (setup, tests) through the shell.                                                                                                                                                                    |
